metadata.coverage_preamble: The day holds the yard, the cake, and her slice at the stair.

yesterday: Nick was king for the first time. Kemp lasted half a paternoster. Sam has the last slice and Heminges's fine.
Eleven pound eight shillings is the sharers' side.
James said twenty-one years, and two to run. That is the whole of the lease he gave the table.
You set down four forsworn men. Tomorrow is the Shrew at two, and you are in it.
